themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents performing research tasks autonomously, from data collection to analysis, often in complex or multi-step processes.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Focuses on AI-powered platforms and tools designed to enhance and accelerate various aspects of research workflows.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Explores the application of AI in the automated testing and evaluation of product usability and functionality.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Features AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and optimizing code.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Highlights AI capabilities for condensing large amounts of text into concise summaries for easier comprehension.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Details how AI is used to analyze datasets, identify patterns, and extract insights for decision-making.

themes.name: Conversational AI in research
themes.description: Covers the use of AI chatbots and conversational agents for conducting research, gathering feedback, and user interaction.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines the effects of AI on employment, job roles, and the skills required in the modern workforce.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of AI-generated user personas or data for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications specifically tailored to support and enhance both the design and user research processes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
